mapper.select: WITH SYXJ AS( SELECT SUM(PF.amount) preSurplusCash /*分配前剩余现金*/ ,PF.portfolio_id FROM ptl_cash_position_flow PF /**设计修改 add by leipeng 20190910**/ INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PC ON PC.PORTFOLIO_ID=PF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PC.ACCT_NO=PF.ACCT_ID AND PC.ACCT_TYPE='${acctType}' AND PF.CCY=PC.CCY WHERE 1=1 AND PF.ccy=#{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PF.hoding_type=#{HODING_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PF.portfolio_id ) SELECT #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} finprodId, fin_product.finprod_name prodName, #{tradeAmt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} tradeAmt, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ccy, ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id portfolioIdSub, ptl_portfolio.portfolio_name portfolioSubName, NULL allotAmt, ptl_portfolio_dis.dis_percent*100 disPercent, SYXJ.preSurplusCash FROM fin_product LEFT JOIN fin_product_add ON fin_product_add.finprod_id=fin_product.finprod_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ON ptl_portfolio.parent_portfolio_id=fin_product_add.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio_dis ON ptl_portfolio_dis.portfolio_id=ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id left join SYXJ ON SYXJ.portfolio_id = ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id WHERE 1=1 AND fin_product.finprod_market_id=#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND fin_product.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH SYXJ AS( SELECT SUM(PF.amount) preSurplusCash /*分配前剩余现金*/ ,PF.portfolio_id FROM ptl_cash_position_flow PF /**设计修改 add by leipeng 20190910**/ INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PC ON PC.PORTFOLIO_ID=PF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PC.ACCT_NO=PF.ACCT_ID AND PC.ACCT_TYPE='${acctType}' AND PF.CCY=PC.CCY WHERE 1=1 AND PF.ccy=#{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PF.hoding_type=#{HODING_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PF.portfolio_id ) SELECT wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id AS totletradeid/*交易编号*/, wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId/*交易编号*/, wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.settle_date AS tradeDate/*交易日*/, wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.portfolio_id AS portfolioid/*组合代码*/, fin_product.finprod_market_id AS finprodid/*产品代码*/, fin_product.finprod_name AS finprodname/*产品名称*/, wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.trade_amt AS tradeamt/*交易金额*/, wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.ccy AS ccy/*币种*/, wfl_trd_product_deal_add.portfolio_id AS portfolioidsub/*子组合代码*/, ptl_portfolio.portfolio_name AS portfoliosubname/*子组合名称*/, wfl_trd_product_deal.trade_amt AS tradeamtfp/*分配金额*/, SYXJ.preSurplusCash AS preSurplusCash ,wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.remark AS remark ,ptl_portfolio_dis.dis_percent*100 AS disPercent ,wfl_trd_product_deal.ps AS ps FROM wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total LEFT JOIN fin_product_add ON fin_product_add.portfolio_id=wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN fin_product ON fin_product.finprod_id=fin_product_add.finprod_id AND fin_product.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal ON wfl_trd_product_deal.totle_trade_id=wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN wfl_trd_product_deal_add ON wfl_trd_product_deal.trade_id=wfl_trd_product_deal_add.trade_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ON ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id=wfl_trd_product_deal_add.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN SYXJ ON SYXJ.portfolio_id = ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio_dis ON ptl_portfolio_dis.portfolio_id=ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id WHERE wfl_trd_fin_product_deal_total.workflow_id=#{workflowId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

WITH SYXJ AS( SELECT SUM(PF.amount) preSurplusCash /*分配前剩余现金*/ ,PF.portfolio_id FROM ptl_cash_position_flow PF /**设计修改 add by leipeng 20190910**/ INNER JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO PC ON PC.PORTFOLIO_ID=PF.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PC.ACCT_NO=PF.ACCT_ID AND PC.ACCT_TYPE='${acctType}' AND PF.CCY=PC.CCY WHERE 1=1 AND PF.ccy=#{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PF.hoding_type=#{HODING_TYPE,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY PF.portfolio_id ) SELECT trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id AS totletradeid/*交易编号*/, trd_fin_product_deal_total.settle_date AS tradeDate/*交易日*/, trd_fin_product_deal_total.portfolio_id AS portfolioid/*组合代码*/, fin_product.finprod_market_id AS finprodid/*产品代码*/, fin_product.finprod_name AS finprodname/*产品名称*/, trd_fin_product_deal_total.trade_amt AS tradeamt/*交易金额*/, trd_fin_product_deal_total.ccy AS ccy/*币种*/, trd_product_deal_add.portfolio_id AS portfolioidsub/*子组合代码*/, ptl_portfolio.portfolio_name AS portfoliosubname/*子组合名称*/, trd_product_deal.trade_amt AS tradeamtfp/*分配金额*/, SYXJ.preSurplusCash AS preSurplusCash ,trd_fin_product_deal_total.remark AS remark ,trd_product_deal.ps AS ps FROM trd_product_deal LEFT JOIN trd_fin_product_deal_total ON trd_product_deal.totle_trade_id = trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id LEFT JOIN fin_product_add ON fin_product_add.portfolio_id = trd_product_deal.finprod_id LEFT JOIN fin_product ON fin_product.finprod_id=fin_product_add.finprod_id AND fin_product.FINPROD_TYPE2=#{finprodType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN trd_product_deal_add ON trd_product_deal.trade_id=trd_product_deal_add.trade_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio ON ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id=trd_product_deal_add.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN SYXJ ON SYXJ.portfolio_id = ptl_portfolio.portfolio_id WHERE trd_fin_product_deal_total.totle_trade_id=#{totleTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
